t.E173.agn: In 2008 EFSA set the tolerable weekly intake (TWI) at 1 mg/kg body weight and reported that this limit may be exceeded in a significant part of the European population. The main sources are cereals, vegetables and drinks; the share of additives could not be measured.
t.E173.body: Aluminium is very poorly absorbed from food (about 0.1%), but the absorbed part may accumulate in tissues, mainly in bone.
t.E173.eff.0.t: Aluminium from all sources may exceed the weekly limit; the absorbed part may accumulate in tissues. The share of additives could not be measured
t.E173.eff.0.w: A significant part of the European population
t.E173.prod: A powder of the metal produced by electrolytic reduction of alumina obtained from bauxite.
t.E173.regx.0: Weekly limit for the whole diet 1 mg/kg; may be exceeded in part of the population.
t.E173.summary: Metallic aluminium powder; gives a silver colour. Used only on the outer surface of confectionery and cake decorations.
t.E173.what: Gives the surface a silver colour.
